title: Draft: feat(mr create): add --depends-on flag
description:
## Description

Adds `--depends-on` to `glab mr create`, letting you mark the new merge request as blocked by one or more existing MRs. Each value is an IID in the current project (e.g. `123`) or a full merge request URL; the flag repeats and accepts comma-separated lists, like `--label`.

GitLab models dependencies as a separate sub-resource (`POST /merge_requests/:iid/blocks`), so the flow is:

1. validate refs syntactically up-front (fail fast on typos)
2. create the MR via the normal `CreateMergeRequest` call
3. for each ref, resolve IID → global ID, then `POST /blocks`

**Partial-failure policy:** the MR is already created and can't be cleanly rolled back, so each failed dependency prints a warning and the command exits 0. The summary line tells the user the exact `glab mr update --add-depends-on …` command to retry with.

Requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate (the dependency API is gated).

## Related Issues

Relates to https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/work_items/7942+

## How has this been tested?

- Unit tests in `internal/commands/mr/create/mr_create_test.go`:
  - `TestNewCmdCreate_DependsOn` — happy path resolves `--depends-on 7` and POSTs `/blocks` with the correct global ID
  - `TestNewCmdCreate_DependsOnInvalidRefFailsFast` — bad ref errors before any HTTP round-trip
- A new `ResolveMRRef` helper is added next to `ParseMRRef` for IID → global-ID lookup; reused by !3306.

## Screenshots (if appropriate):

N/A — CLI flag only; generated docs are included in `docs/source/mr/create.md`.

title: fix(security): resolve real GID before detaching scan profiles
description:
## Description

`disable` built a synthetic GID from the profile's scan-type string,
the same type used to attach built-in default profiles. Once a
profile is attached, though, GitLab tracks it under a persisted
numeric GID, so the detach mutation sent the wrong ID and failed with
"resource does not exist" even though the profile was attached.

Look up the persisted GID via scanProfileStatuses first, same as
`status` already does, then detach with that.

## Related Issues

Fixes https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/work_items/8492

## How has this been tested?

1. `make`
1. `bin/glab -R <group/project> security config disable dependency_scanning_post_processing`
1. Verify that disablement works!
1. `bin/glab -R <group/project> security config enable dependency_scanning_post_processing`

## Screenshots (if appropriate):

```
➜  cli git:(664822a11) bin/glab security config disable dependency_scanning_post_processing -R gitlab-org/secure/tests/otovar/auto-remediation-bun
✓ Disabled the "dependency_scanning_post_processing" security scan profile for gitlab-org/secure/tests/otovar/auto-remediation-bun.
➜  cli git:(664822a11) bin/glab security config enable dependency_scanning_post_processing -R gitlab-org/secure/tests/otovar/auto-remediation-bun
✓ Enabled the "dependency_scanning_post_processing" security scan profile for gitlab-org/secure/tests/otovar/auto-remediation-bun.
```
